residue_census_repin.rationale: D6 hosted certification publishes, waives and archives run-scoped qa_<run>_ requirements in QA Shared. Slice 5/6 added the audited purge (document_requirement_purge, QA orgs and the run's namespace only). Without these three checks the registered census cannot see whether that purge ran, so a bound ZERO_RESIDUE would not prove zero requirement residue.
